frequency_question: How often do Department of Education termination or non-renewal proceedings against an accrediting agency result in a final revocation order within the designated timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes all formal Department of Education actions initiated to strip an institutional or programmatic accreditor of its federal recognition status. Excludes voluntary relinquishments of recognition or minor compliance agreements that do not involve revocation proceedings.
